options.name: ah_host
options.description: URL to Ansible Galaxy or Automation Hub instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(AH_HOST) If value not specified by any means, the value of C(127.0.0.1) will be used

options.name: ah_password
options.description: Password for your Ansible Galaxy or Automation Hub instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(AH_PASSWORD)

options.name: ah_path_prefix
options.description: API path used to access the api. For galaxy_ng this is either 'automation-hub' or the custom prefix used on install with GALAXY_API_PATH_PREFIX For Automation Hub this is 'galaxy'

options.name: ah_username
options.description: Username for your Ansible Galaxy or Automation Hub instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(AH_USERNAME)

options.name: auth_url
options.description: Remote URL for the repository authentication if separate.

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: A PEM encoded CA certificate used for authentication. Mutually exclusive with C(ca_cert_path)

options.name: ca_cert_path
options.description: Path to a PEM encoded CA certificate used for authentication. Mutually exclusive with C(ca_cert)

options.name: client_cert
options.description: A PEM encoded client certificate used for authentication. Mutually exclusive with C(client_cert_path)

options.name: client_cert_path
options.description: Path to a PEM encoded client certificate used for authentication. Mutually exclusive with C(client_cert)

options.name: client_key
options.description: A PEM encoded private key file used for authentication. Mutually exclusive with C(client_key_path)

options.name: client_key_path
options.description: Path to a PEM encoded private key file used for authentication. Mutually exclusive with C(client_key)

options.name: download_concurrency
options.description: Number of concurrent collections to download.

options.name: max_retries
options.description: Retries to use when running sync. Default is 0 which does not limit.

options.name: name
options.description: Remote Repository name. Probably one of community validated, or rh-certified.

options.name: password
options.description: Password to authenticate to the remote repository.

options.name: policy
options.description: The policy to use when downloading content.
choices: When syncing, download all metadata and content now.

options.name: proxy_password
options.description: Proxy URL to use for the connection

options.name: proxy_url
options.description: Proxy URL to use for the connection

options.name: proxy_username
options.description: Proxy URL to use for the connection

options.name: rate_limit
options.description: Limits total download rate in requests per second.

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the Galaxy or Automation Hub host. Defaults to 10s, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code

options.name: requirements
options.description: Requirements to download from remote.

options.name: requirements_file
options.description: A yaml requirements file to download from remote.

options.name: signed_only
options.description: Whether to only download signed collections

options.name: state
options.description: If C(absent), then the module deletes the remote repository. The module does not fail if the remote repository does not exist because the state is already as expected. If C(present), then the module updates the description and README file for the remote repository.

options.name: sync_dependencies
options.description: Whether to download depenencies when syncing collections.

options.name: tls_validation
options.description: Whether to use TLS validation against the remote repository.

options.name: token
options.description: Token to authenticate to the remote repository.

options.name: url
options.description: Remote URL for the repository.

options.name: username
options.description: Username to authenticate to the remote repository.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to allow insecure connections to Galaxy or Automation Hub Server. If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If value not set, will try environment variable C(AH_VERIFY_SSL)
